title: RiskScoredRecord
description: Execution Plan section 3.2. Produced by A2 risk engine, consumed by A4 API. peer_group is mandatory on every flagged record, not optional -- eng review enforces a minimum n of 30, below which the work is excluded from flagging rather than flagged on a meaningless z-score.

inspection_rank.description: 1 = inspect first. Must run 1..N with no gaps across the full scored set (Checkpoints CP2).

flags.description: No minimum count required (Checkpoints CP2, revised 2026-09-01: a minimum-count gate pays you to loosen thresholds until it passes). Empty array means unflagged, not clean.

why_flagged.description: One key per entry in flags, each value a plain-language sentence from contracts/strings.json. No accusatory language, no em-dashes.

label.description: e.g. 'Road works, Bihar, 2023-24'. Category, then state, then year, per NIDHINETRA-DESIGN-BRIEF.md.

n.description: Eng review minimum. Below 30 the work must not be flagged at all rather than carry a peer_group with a small n.

peer_group.description: Mandatory (non-null) whenever flags is non-empty. Null only when flags is empty.
